gameDescriptionHtml:
A war chess game that you build random characters, skills and weapon combinations, and raid random levels!

Characters: More than a dozen heroes with very different combat performance and fighting styles, each with their own strengths, waiting for you to choose and unlock!

Weapons: Hundreds of weapons are waiting to be unlocked and collected.

With different weapons in hand, character’s attack range, skills and attack animations may change accordingly.

Skills: Skill effects are diverse and the performance is gorgeous. Hundreds of skill combinations are available, and the must-kill skill can change the character’s combat positioning, bringing a brand new game experience.

Simple operation. Under the premise of retaining the core gameplay of randomly constructed combinations, the game supports acceleration and automatic skill releasing, making it easy to control the pace.

The playability has been verified by tens of thousands of players with hundreds of hours of average play time, and the war chess is re-optimized and adjusted based on the core gameplay, providing you with more abundant game content and more interesting game experience.
